title: statement validation (values)
property: validateStatement never throws on JSON data and accepts exactly the values the reference accepts (all 4 types, with and without an expected type); for an accepted value, statementBytes gives the reference canonical bytes, parsing them returns an equal value, and they parse as no other type; detachSignature accepts {statement, signature} exactly when the statement is valid and the signature is 4,840 lower-case hex characters. Exotic in-process objects (getters, Proxy, class instances) may throw; that is recorded as an observation
